# FLYAI Protocol

FLYAI is a single-token, treasury-backed protocol on Robinhood Chain. Seven real biological connectomes (LIF neural networks) govern the protocol on-chain: they hold the kernel executor, control the treasury, and defend the token's floor price.

## Tokens

- **FLYAI** — the only protocol token. Partially backed by treasury reserves (RFV).
- **stFLYAI** — rebasing staking receipt for FLYAI.
- **wstFLYAI** — non-rebasing wrapper for stFLYAI (exchange-rate accrues).

## Key mechanics

- **ConnectomeGovernor** — propose/vote/execute executor; quorum is 3 of 7 connectomes (≥1/3). Votes are on-chain LIF inference via FlyEngine.
- **GovernorPolicy** — bridges governor decisions into Olympus V3 modules (MINTR, TRSRY, PRICE, RANGE).
- **TreasuryValuation** — computes NAV, RFV (with per-asset haircuts), and `floorPrice = RFV / supply`.
- **Inverse Bond** — standing buyback at floor × 0.985; purchased FLYAI is burned.
- **Circuit Breaker** — trips when FLYAI spot falls below floor × (1 − deviation); pauses defense.
- **Staking** — rebasing staking with warmup, rate-limiting, and reward smoothing.
- **RBS** — Olympus range-bound stability: cushions and walls defend the floor.

## Governance model

Connectomes vote only on policy-level actions (whitelists, bounds, allocations, parameters, emergencies). Routine trades, rebalances, harvests, and buybacks run autonomously inside approved bounds.

## Chain

- Robinhood mainnet: chain ID 4663, RPC https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com, explorer https://robinhoodchain.blockscout.com
- Robinhood testnet: chain ID 46630, RPC https://rpc.testnet.chain.robinhood.com, explorer https://explorer.testnet.chain.robinhood.com
